I was lucky to receive the FISP coupon this season, so I will apply one bag of NPK and some urea on this maize plot because it is my main field, and I will plant the hybrid seed I got from the program too. We do not have livestock to give us manure, and pesticides are too expensive for food crops, so I will not use those. My family will do all the work on this small plot since we cannot afford to hire anyone, and we have no irrigation here in Balaka so we wait for the rains.
